title: MoveInSync
description: MoveInSync stands as the world’s largest employee commute platform, serving over 400 clients, including 97 Fortune 500 companies. Headquartered in Bangalore, India, MoveInSync has pioneered employee commuting solutions since 2009, providing reliable, safe, and sustainable options for enterprises. The solution empowers organizations to reduce carbon emissions through shared commutes, optimal fleet management, and the adoption of electric vehicles. MoveInSync One offers a comprehensive employee transport solution, integrating fleet, technology, and operations. With over 7200 vehicles, including 925 EVs, we prioritize reliability, safety, and sustainability. Seamlessly integrating our fleet with cutting-edge technology and top-notch operational delivery, we provide an unparalleled way for clients to manage their operations. The SaaS solution automates employees' office commutes, corporate car rentals, and workplace management (www.workinsync.io). It identifies and mitigates risks, ensures ESG compliance, and enhances employee satisfaction. It manages cabs, EVs, and shuttles for various travel needs, featuring scheduling, routing, tracking, billing, safety, security, compliance, and reporting. MoveInSync has earned numerous awards, including Deloitte India Technology Fast 50 - 2023, G2 Best India Software Companies for 2023, and Mint W3 Future of Work Disruptor 2021. With MoveInSync, whether managing your workplace or employee commute, everything becomes more straightforward. This single app can transform your workplace for the better. Please Note: Register on the app using the mobile number or email available in your office records. Kindly reach out to your organisation’s Transport Manager, Facility Manager or HR Manager in case you face any problem in registration on the app.
